basic_profile.bio: A 32-year-old tech enthusiast and outdoor lover from Portland, Oregon. I work as a software engineer for a local startup focused on fitness tech solutions. I love integrating technology into my fitness routines, whether it's tracking my runs or syncing my workouts with apps. In my downtime, I enjoy exploring the Pacific Northwest with my trusty Honda Ridgeline and experimenting with DIY projects around the house. I’m currently single and typically online during the evenings after work and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science, I've always been fascinated by how technology can enhance everyday life. My career in software development has further deepened my understanding of tech, particularly in the realm of fitness and lifestyle applications. I often explore new tech trends and enjoy sharing insights on integrating technology with fitness.
